summary: Describes the need for a new IANA Diameter command code for a vendor-specific application that invokes policy processing, such as policy evaluation or enforcement. It supports the PEM-1 interface in the Open Mobile Alliance's Policy Evaluation, Enforcement and Management enabler. It is informational.

plainLanguage.summary: This memo describes Diameter identifiers used for policy-processing requests and responses in an Open Mobile Alliance application. It lists the command code, AVP value, and application identifier.

subtitle: Diameter identifiers for the Policy Evaluation, Enforcement, and Management application.

tldr.problem: The Open Mobile Alliance PEEM enabler needs a Diameter application for policy-processing requests and responses on its PEM-1 interface.
tldr.mechanism: The memo describes a vendor-specific application using Diameter Command Code 314, a Policy-Data AVP, and Application Identifier 16777243.
tldr.outcome: RFC 5224 records the assigned code values and refers to the PEEM technical specification for their detailed use. It is informational.

today: The unit metadata lists RFC 5224 as Informational and records no RFC that obsoletes or updates it. The memo describes Diameter codes for the OMA PEEM policy-processing application.

sections.title: Policy Processing over Diameter
sections.content:
The Diameter Policy Processing Application supports invocation of policy processing, including policy evaluation or evaluation and enforcement. It is described as one realization of the Open Mobile Alliance Policy Evaluation, Enforcement, and Management (PEEM) enabler.

The application uses the Diameter Base protocol and extends it for a specific vendor application. The RFC summarizes the relevant codes; the detailed procedure is defined in the PEM-1 Technical Specification.
sections.plainLanguage: The application uses Diameter to carry policy requests and their results. This RFC records the identifiers, while the cited PEEM specification describes how to use them.

sections.title: Request and Result Data
sections.content:
The application uses a new command code and a vendor-specific application identifier. Policy-processing input is carried in a new Attribute-Value Pair (AVP); results use that AVP together with the Experimental-Result AVP.

The memo says the application, combined with the Diameter Base protocol, satisfies PEEM's requirements for sending a policy-processing request and receiving a response containing the result.
sections.plainLanguage: The request carries policy input in an AVP. The response uses that AVP and an Experimental-Result AVP to carry the result.

sections.title: Diameter Code Values
sections.content:
IANA assigned Command Code 314 with the name PDR / PDA. The memo uses value 1 for the Policy-Data AVP in the OMA Vendor-ID namespace and Application Identifier 16777243 for the Policy Processing Application.

The assigned values belong to namespaces defined by the Diameter Base protocol and must be coordinated within those namespaces.
sections.plainLanguage: The memo lists the Diameter numbers reserved for this application so its messages can be identified in the shared code spaces.
